title: Attila the Hun to Squidward: a fresco, 266 popes and a Jedi
description: A Raphael fresco, the line of popes, two White House visits and a Hollywood ceremony connect Attila the Hun to Squidward, through his voice, Rodger Bumpass.
hook: How is Attila the Hun connected to Squidward?

image.file: File:Raphael - The Meeting of Leo the Great and Attila.jpg

links.line: Around 1514, Raphael painted Pope Leo I meeting Attila the Hun, who spared Rome in 452.

links.line: From Leo, the 45th pope, the line runs unbroken to the 266th, Pope Francis.

image.file: File:Pope Francis and Joe Biden at the White House.jpg

links.line: In 2015, Vice President Joe Biden greeted Pope Francis at the White House.
In 2024, President Biden welcomed Star Wars legend Mark Hamill to the Oval Office.

image.credit: Getty Images for Paramount Pictures, via Mulderville

links.line: In 2025, Hamill, the Flying Dutchman in the new SpongeBob movie, posed with the cast, including Rodger Bumpass.
And Rodger Bumpass has been the voice of Squidward since 1999.
